driver: tokenomics.train.orderer_improve --enriched --stochastic (M2 expert iteration; deterministic mean -> learned per-dim log_std + sampled deploy; producer fixed v4, orderer obs v2)
question: EXP-0006A (clean) showed enriched v2 obs is only a partial lever: M2-v3-obs still misses the strict envelope on s6 (0.99) and s9 (0.96), and BOTH of those seeds' envelope-best is stock_aware+RANDOM -> the residual is routing diversity, not state. Does distilling a STOCHASTIC orderer (learn log_std by masked Gaussian NLL, deploy by sampling) recover that diversity and beat the strict random-inclusive envelope on all held-out seeds 6,7,8,9 with zero death?

params.search_teacher: directed routing search, lookahead=12, K(samples)=12, candidates {even_split, proportional, obs_price}
params.loss: masked Gaussian NLL over decode-active orderer dims (fits mean + per-dim log_std); masked dims keep init
params.deploy: sample a ~ Normal(mean, exp(log_std)), clip to +/-bound; per-episode RNG = env.action_space(agent).np_random (P2: order-independent per seed)
params.control: identical to EXP-0006A (clean) M2-v3-obs except deterministic clip(mean) deploy -> learned-log_std sampled deploy; orderer log_std NOT clamped to the producer greedy value on save

configs.topologies: tokenomics.eval.scale.build_scale_config(seed, depth=3) — same fixed scale suite as EXP-0004/0005/0006A

compute.where: runpod CPU pod 3joly6h2z0hboa (8 vCPU, runpod/base:0.7.0-ubuntu2004, python3.12, torch 2.12.1+cpu) via run_pod_training.py --cpu --python python3.12 (DETACHED client-server mode)

verdict: ACCEPT (strict primary gate). M2-v3-stochastic beats the strict random-inclusive envelope on ALL held-out seeds 6,7,8,9 (1.026/1.086/1.057/1.022 @10 seeds; 1.032/1.085/1.053/1.019 @40-seed audit), zero death. Hard-cell met: s6 0.99->1.026 and s9 0.96->1.022 (s9 also > M2-v1 0.91). 40-eval-seed confidence audit RESOLVES the s9 mean-only caveat: all 4 clear at the lower 95% CI bound (s9 501.3 > env 498.3). Mean env 1.047 (< secondary 1.10, 'if feasible'; CI tightening does not move the mean). First policy in the EXP-0001->0006 arc to clear the strict envelope everywhere. Checkpoint md5 7be79ccbd90e, v2 fp 548120bd, 64 learned log_std dims.

gates.primary: M2-v3-stochastic envelope ratio > 1.00 on ALL held-out seeds 6,7,8,9 (mean +/- 95% CI over 10 stochastic eval seeds)
gates.hard-cell: s6 and s9 (the sa+random misses in EXP-0006A) must improve over M2-v3-obs (0.99, 0.96)
